description: Database layer for Portfolio Stress Lab: new Supabase migrations (tables, RLS+grants, SECURITY DEFINER RPCs), the 5-scenario seed, and hand-maintained DB types. Snapshot-based so simulation records survive later trades; per-user RLS; writes RPC-only. Independent of the TS feature code but a prerequisite for FEAT-003's hooks. Mirrors the trading-ledger migration conventions exactly.
steps: Create supabase/migrations/20250108000001_stress_lab_tables.sql defining: stress_scenarios (id text pk; name/description/cause/conditions/expected_impacts/learning_objective text not null; severity text check in ('low','medium','high','severe'); assumptions jsonb not null; sort_order int not null; is_active boolean not null default true) and the user-owned tables stress_simulations, stress_predictions, stress_reflections, stress_challenge_progress exactly as specified in design.md 'Data model -> Tables' (user_id text references public.profiles(user_id) on delete cascade; scenario_id text references public.stress_scenarios(id); jsonb holdings_snapshot/assumptions_snapshot/asset_results; id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid() for simulations/predictions/reflections; stress_challenge_progress composite primary key (user_id, scenario_id, challenge_id)). Add the two stress_simulations indexes: (user_id, created_at desc) and (user_id, scenario_id, created_at desc). Use stress_predictions.simulation_id unique. Follow the header-comment style of supabase/migrations/20250105000002_trading_ledger.sql.

Create supabase/migrations/20250108000002_stress_lab_rls_and_grants.sql: enable RLS on all five tables; stress_scenarios gets `create policy "read reference" ... for select to authenticated using (true)`; the four user tables get `create policy "own rows" ... for select to authenticated using (user_id = (select public.current_user_id()))`; then `revoke all on <five tables> from anon, authenticated;` and `grant select on <five tables> to authenticated;` with NO insert/update/delete grants. Mirror supabase/migrations/20250105000003_market_trading_rls_and_grants.sql.

Create supabase/migrations/20250108000003_stress_lab_rpcs.sql with all functions `language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public`, deriving `v_uid := public.current_user_id()` (raise 'not_authenticated' when null), granted to authenticated only. record_simulation(p_scenario_id text, p_phase text default 'shock') returns public.stress_simulations: validate active scenario (raise 'unknown_scenario'/'scenario_inactive'), load caller paper_accounts (raise 'no_account'), read positions joined to instruments (name, sector, type) and quotes (missing quote => value 0), build holdings_snapshot, per holding shock = (assumptions->'sectors'->>sector)::numeric else (assumptions->>'broad_market')::numeric, simulated = value + round(value*shock) floored at 0, assemble asset_results + totals + change_cents + change_basis_points (null when starting 0), insert and return the row. For p_phase='recovery' use assumptions->'recovery' table applied to CURRENT holdings (independent, NOT composed on crash — design-review NIT-3); 'recovery' only meaningful for covid_2020, otherwise fall back to base table. save_prediction(p_simulation_id uuid, p_direction text, p_estimated_change_bp int, p_best text, p_worst text) returns stress_predictions: verify ownership, compute accuracy jsonb vs stored result, unique-upsert on simulation_id. save_reflection(p_simulation_id uuid, p_responses jsonb) returns stress_reflections: verify ownership, require jsonb array (reject empty), clamp answer length. upsert_challenge_progress(p_scenario_id text, p_challenge_id text, p_status text, p_simulation_id uuid) returns stress_challenge_progress: verify referenced simulation owned by caller, upsert composite PK, increment attempts, stamp met_at on flip to 'met'. Follow supabase/migrations/20250105000006_place_market_order_rpc.sql.

Create supabase/seed/stress_scenarios.sql as an idempotent `insert into public.stress_scenarios(...) values ... on conflict (id) do update set ...` (mirror supabase/seed/instruments.sql header + idempotency) encoding all 5 scenarios with the authoritative shock tables from design.md section Q2 — each assumptions jsonb = { "broad_market": <n>, "sectors": { all 11 sectors }, and for covid_2020 additionally "recovery": { "broad_market": <n>, "sectors": {...} } }. Then append "./seed/stress_scenarios.sql" to the END of the sql_paths array in supabase/config.toml [db.seed] (after "./seed/holidays.sql" — design-review NIT-1).

Edit src/types/db.ts (hand-maintained): add Row/Insert/Update entries for stress_scenarios, stress_simulations, stress_predictions, stress_reflections, stress_challenge_progress under Tables, and add record_simulation, save_prediction, save_reflection, upsert_challenge_progress under Functions with Args/Returns matching the migrations — follow the existing place_market_order / complete_lesson entries' structure.
acceptance_criteria: `npx supabase db reset` applies all three new migrations and the new seed with no error.
After reset, `select count(*) from stress_scenarios` returns 5 and each row's assumptions jsonb contains broad_market and all 11 seeded sectors; covid_2020 also has a recovery object.
`select * from public.record_simulation('crisis_2008')` against a seeded scratch DB returns one stress_simulations row with non-null holdings_snapshot, assumptions_snapshot, and asset_results.
No applied (pre-existing) migration file is modified; only new 20250108* files are added plus the config.toml seed registration.
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes with the new db.ts entries.
verification: Run a psql query against the local DB: `select count(*) from stress_scenarios;` returns 5; `select * from record_simulation('crisis_2008');` returns a row (seed a paper_account + positions first or accept no_account as proof the auth guard runs).
findings:
DB-APPLY LIMITATION: Docker is not running in this environment, so `npx supabase db reset` could not be executed (CLI v2.119.0 present at /opt/homebrew/bin/supabase; `docker info` fails: 'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon'). SQL was authored exactly to the trading-ledger conventions and `npx tsc --noEmit` passes with the new db.ts entries. The convergence step MUST run `cd .worktrees/portfolio-stress-lab && npx supabase db reset` once Docker is up and confirm: count(*) from stress_scenarios = 5; each assumptions has broad_market + all 11 sectors; covid_2020 also has a recovery object; `select * from record_simulation('crisis_2008')` returns a row (or raises no_account/not_authenticated proving the guard). Seed JSON was statically validated here (node JSON.parse): all 5 blocks have broad_market + 11 sectors, only covid_2020 carries recovery.

FILES ADDED (never editing an applied migration; only new 20250108* files + config.toml seed registration):
- supabase/migrations/20250108000001_stress_lab_tables.sql
- supabase/migrations/20250108000002_stress_lab_rls_and_grants.sql
- supabase/migrations/20250108000003_stress_lab_rpcs.sql
- supabase/seed/stress_scenarios.sql (appended to END of config.toml [db.seed] sql_paths, after ./seed/holidays.sql — NIT-1)
- src/types/db.ts (5 tables + 4 RPC signatures)

TABLES (public schema):
- stress_scenarios (reference, seeded): id text PK; name/description/cause/conditions/expected_impacts/learning_objective text NOT NULL; severity text check in ('low','medium','high','severe'); assumptions jsonb NOT NULL { broad_market:number, sectors:{<sector>:number}, recovery?:{broad_market,sectors} }; sort_order int NOT NULL; is_active boolean NOT NULL default true.
- stress_simulations (user-owned, append-only, snapshot): id uuid PK default gen_random_uuid() (SERVER-generated, no client id/idempotency key — NIT-2); user_id text -> profiles(user_id) on delete cascade; scenario_id text -> stress_scenarios(id); phase text NOT NULL default 'shock' check in ('shock','recovery'); starting_value_cents bigint; simulated_value_cents bigint; change_cents bigint; change_basis_points int NULL (null when starting value 0); cash_cents bigint; holdings_snapshot jsonb; assumptions_snapshot jsonb; asset_results jsonb; created_at timestamptz default now(). Indexes: stress_simulations_user_created_idx (user_id, created_at desc); stress_simulations_user_scenario_created_idx (user_id, scenario_id, created_at desc).
- stress_predictions (user-owned): id uuid PK; simulation_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE -> stress_simulations(id) on delete cascade; user_id text; direction text check in ('gain','lose'); estimated_change_bp int NULL; picked_best text NULL; picked_worst text NULL; accuracy jsonb NULL (server-computed); created_at.
- stress_reflections (user-owned): id uuid PK; simulation_id uuid -> stress_simulations(id) on delete cascade (NOT unique); user_id text; responses jsonb NOT NULL; created_at.
- stress_challenge_progress (user-owned): composite PK (user_id, scenario_id, challenge_id); status text check in ('in_progress','met'); best_simulation_id uuid NULL -> stress_simulations(id); attempts int default 0; met_at timestamptz NULL; updated_at.

RLS/GRANTS: RLS enabled on all 5. stress_scenarios policy "read reference" for select to authenticated using (true). Four user tables policy "own rows" using (user_id = (select public.current_user_id())). revoke all from anon, authenticated; grant select to authenticated. NO insert/update/delete grants — writes are RPC-only.

RPC SIGNATURES (all language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, granted to authenticated only; derive v_uid := public.current_user_id(), raise 'not_authenticated' if null):
- record_simulation(p_scenario_id text, p_phase text default 'shock') returns public.stress_simulations. Validates scenario (raise 'unknown_scenario' if missing, 'scenario_inactive' if not active), loads caller paper_accounts (raise 'no_account'), reads positions join instruments (name, sector) left join quotes (missing quote => value 0), per holding shock = assumptions->'sectors'->><sector> when present else assumptions->>'broad_market', simulated = greatest(value + round(value*shock), 0), cash pass-through. p_phase='recovery' uses assumptions->'recovery' applied to CURRENT holdings (independent, NOT composed — NIT-3); only meaningful for covid_2020, otherwise falls back to base table. Also raises 'invalid_phase' for phases outside ('shock','recovery').
- save_prediction(p_simulation_id uuid, p_direction text, p_estimated_change_bp int default null, p_best text default null, p_worst text default null) returns public.stress_predictions. Verifies ownership (raise 'not_found'), validates direction in ('gain','lose') and estimated_change_bp within [-10000,10000] (raise 'invalid_prediction'), computes accuracy jsonb {direction_correct, actual_direction, actual_change_bp, estimate_error_bp, best_correct, worst_correct, actual_best, actual_worst} where actual_best/worst are symbols by max/min simulated_change_bp, unique-upsert on simulation_id.
- save_reflection(p_simulation_id uuid, p_responses jsonb) returns public.stress_reflections. Verifies ownership (raise 'not_found'), requires non-empty jsonb array (raise 'invalid_reflection'), clamps each element's string 'answer' to 280 chars.
- upsert_challenge_progress(p_scenario_id text, p_challenge_id text, p_status text, p_simulation_id uuid default null) returns public.stress_challenge_progress. Validates status in ('in_progress','met') (raise 'invalid_challenge'), if p_simulation_id supplied verifies it is owned by caller (raise 'not_found'), upserts composite PK, increments attempts, stamps met_at on flip into 'met'.

ERROR CODES (stable strings for client mapping): not_authenticated, no_account, unknown_scenario, scenario_inactive, invalid_phase, not_found, invalid_prediction, invalid_reflection, invalid_challenge.

SEED SCENARIO IDS (sort_order): crisis_2008 (1, severe), covid_2020 (2, high, HAS recovery), high_inflation (3, medium), rising_rates (4, medium), recession (5, high). Shock values match design.md Q2 exactly. Canonical 11 sectors (assumptions.sectors keys): Information Technology, Financials, Consumer Discretionary, Consumer Staples, Health Care, Energy, Industrials, Materials, Utilities, Real Estate, Communication Services.

asset_results element shape (for FEAT-003 zod schema): { symbol, name, sector, qty, original_value_cents, shock, used_broad_market, simulated_change_cents, simulated_change_bp (null when original 0), simulated_value_cents }. holdings_snapshot element: { symbol, name, sector, qty, current_value_cents }. assumptions_snapshot = the shock table actually used (base, or the recovery sub-object for a recovery run).
